title: Close every decision with a free-text C line in the three style files
description: Each of the three style files decision section gains one line offering a free-text answer (C: tell me a different answer, or Other), per the design in opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-skill-design.md at opum-doc origin/main 1312f0c, section Changes this needs in plain-english-styles item 2. The files also state that C is not a third option. The existing two options never three rule stays, worded so it cannot read as banning C.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of the three style files decision section closes with a line offering a free-text answer
Each style file states the free-text line is not a third option
Each style file keeps its two options never three rule, worded so it cannot read as banning C
The harness contract audit (node src/cli.mjs audit run from harness) exits 0

implementationNotes: Close evidence. PES-4's work already shipped in commit 3b47bfe 'feat(PES-4): close every decision with a free-text C line (#48)'. That commit edited the three style files but its tracker move closed PES-3, not PES-4, so PES-4 was left To Do with its work merged. Criterion 1 (each style file's decision section closes with a free-text line): output-styles/plain-english-beginner.md:86, plain-english-intermediate.md:70 and plain-english-advanced.md:56 all carry the line 'C: tell me a different answer'. Criterion 2 (each states the free-text line is not a third option): beginner:86 'This is not a third option.', intermediate:70 'C is not a third option', advanced:58 'C is a different answer, not a third option.' Criterion 3 (each keeps its two-options-never-three rule, worded so it cannot read as banning C): beginner:88 'Never offer more than two options, A and B. C asks for a different answer, so it is not a third option.', intermediate:72 'Never offer more than two options, A and B. C invites a different answer and does not count as a third.', advanced:58 'Two options, never three - A and B. C is a different answer, not a third option.' Criterion 4 (harness contract audit exits 0): node harness/src/cli.mjs audit - all 12 checks agree. All verified by reading the files on this branch this session.
